name: project_status
title: Project status update
description: Project or programme status: overall status (schedule, budget, scope), milestones, progress, risks and issues, decisions needed, next steps.
storyline: Lead with the overall status and what changed since last time; end with the decisions you need. State status in words (On track / At risk / Late), not only colours.

slots.title: <Overall status in one sentence>
slots.guidance: Tiles for Overall, Schedule, Budget, Scope with a word status and the change since last report.

slots.title: <Where the milestones stand>
slots.guidance: Milestones with dates; mark done and late ones in the label.

slots.title: <Progress against plan>
slots.guidance: Planned vs actual (completion, burn-up or spend) over time.

slots.title: <The risks and issues that need attention>
slots.guidance: Risk | Impact | Owner | Mitigation; the top 3-5 only.

slots.title: <Decisions we need from you>
slots.guidance: Each decision, the options and the date it is needed by.

slots.title: Next steps: who does what by when
slots.guidance: Columns Action | Owner | Due. One row per commitment; a named owner and a date on every row.
